registered: see the git commit that added this file (2026-10-05), after H4 completed (as instructed) and before any H3 training
authorisation: 2026-10-04 research-program mission, section 9.1 Priority 3 ('LR/batch sensitivity: determine whether the missing DFSC effect is optimization-sensitive'); 2026-10-05 instruction: pre-register H3 after H4 completes
class: CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT, Phase B (one factor changed relative to the faithful reproduction; reported apart from the reproduction columns)

questions.H3a_test_surplus: Does the optimisation regime explain why our test mSA is 4-5 pt above the paper while validation matches? Our Phase A uses 1 GPU x batch 2 with linearly scaled LR 0.0025 = 14,400 optimizer steps; an 8-GPU x 2 mmdetection run (the convention behind 'LR 0.02, batch 2 per GPU') takes 1,800 steps at LR 0.02.
questions.H3b_dfsc_effect: Does DFSC's gain over plain fine-tuning (paper +0.49 val / +0.68 test) appear in the paper's optimisation regime, given that it is absent in ours (-0.03 / -0.29 seed 0; +0.07 / -0.08 seed 1)?

controlled_variable: optimisation regime only: gradient accumulation 8 (effective batch 16) and LR 0.02, same 18 epochs, same LR steps (x0.1 at epochs 12 and 15), warm-up 500 OPTIMIZER steps (engine/train.py it_global; the mmdetection 8-GPU convention), i.e. 1,800 optimizer steps over the same 28,800 training pairs
held_fixed: data and pair sampling (1,600 pairs/epoch), architecture, COCO_V1 initialisation, seed 0, losses, augmentation, final-epoch checkpoint (no selection), tracker, metric, frozen split manifests, evaluation at the training scale (1000x800)
run_order: train normal, train DFSC (interrupted training resumes from last.pt), evaluate both on VAL, then both on TEST once with --final-eval (two new checkpoints, one ledger line each), then scripts/analyze_h3.py; all steps run regardless of intermediate results

H3a.SUPPORTED: for both arms: |val - paper val| <= 1.0 AND |test - paper test| <= 1.0
H3a.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: for both arms: |val - paper val| <= 1.0 AND (Phase A test - H3 test) >= 0.5 x (Phase A test - paper test)

H3b.OBSERVED: DFSC - normal >= +0.4 on both val and test (single seed: a screening result; a seed-1 pair would be the follow-up)
H3b.NOT_OBSERVED: DFSC - normal <= +0.1 on at least one split

known_limitations: one seed per arm (observed Phase A seed range up to 0.36 pt on test, so H3b is a screening test); single implementation (torchvision), single modality (IR)
context_at_registration: H4 (native evaluation scale) came out NOT_SUPPORTED_VAL_BREAKS: a symmetric -4 pt drop on both splits, i.e. train/test scale mismatch; H3's design and rules do not depend on it
